title: Ingoro y'ikirahure cy'indorerwamo
intro: Tekereza igihugu cya kure cy’ubutunzi n’ubwiza aho izuba risengwa aho gusenga Umuremyi waryo. Ibaruwa iraza ifite ubutumwa budashobora kwirengagizwa, maze urugendo rutangira rwerekeza mu rukiko ruruta izindi zose zabayeho mbere. Aho ngaho, uburiganya buzashyirwa ahagaragara n’ahantu hashuka amaso, kandi akanya ko gusobanukirwa neza kazahindura byose.
clues: Nategetse igihugu gikize cyane, abantu bacyo bapfukamiraga izuba aho kuramya Imana.
Nakiriye ibaruwa nziza impamagarira kutishyira hejuru ahubwo ko ngomba kugandukira Imana.
Nagishije inama inama njyanama yanjye maze mbanza guhitamo dipolomasi, nohereza impano yo kugerageza uwayitumye.
Nageze kwa Sulayman, maze intebe yanjye bwite inyerezwa inyihishe kugira ngo imenyekane ko ndi Imana.
Ninjiraga mu ngoro ndende cyane, aho hasi h’ibirahure byoroshye nibwiraga ko ari amazi maremare.
Natangaje ko niyeguriye Imana, Umwami w’isi yose, na Sulayman.

trial.label: Igeragezwa/Ikibazo
options: Yamizwe n'ifi nini mu nda y'inyanja
Yahuye n'uburwayi n'urupfu rw'umuryango we imyaka myinshi
Yategetswe gutamba umwana we akunda mu nzozi
Byageragejwe n'intebe y'ubwami yihishe n'ingoro y'ibirahure
Yajugunywe mu muriro ugurumana azira kumenagura ibigirwamana
trial.answer: Byageragejwe n'intebe y'ubwami yihishe n'ingoro y'ibirahure

location.label: Ikintu cy'ingenzi
options: Uruzi rwa Nili mu gihe cyo kuva mu Misiri

outcome.label: Ibisubizo
options: Nagumye mu bujiji kandi narimbuwe n'abantu banjye
Yashyikirijwe na Sulayman kuri Allah, Umwami w'isi yose
Yarohamye mu nyanja ubwo yakurikiranaga abizera
outcome.answer: Yashyikirijwe na Sulayman kuri Allah, Umwami w'isi yose

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
